enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Bends knees. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Extends arm. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves legs. Pulls blanket down. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and butter. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Place tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Rinse mug. Place mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work uniform, packing bag and checking phone for shift notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out uniform. Put on trousers. Put on shirt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Open bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Put notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open shift notes app. Read notes. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to facility. Enter building. Show ID to security. Walk to locker room. Change into work shoes. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Enter ward. Greet colleagues. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Record notes in chart. Move to next patient. Repeat assessment. Attend team meeting. Update electronic records. Prepare handover notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select sandwich and fruit. Pay at cashier. Sit at table. Open sandwich wrapper. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague about patient case. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties: patient care, handover preparation and record updates
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient status. Administer afternoon medications. Assist patient with mobility. Change wound dressing. Update nursing notes. Attend handover meeting. Report patient conditions to incoming shift. Review medication orders. Confirm next day's appointments. File paperwork.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Add spices. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Check phone. Watch movie.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher, running it before the electricity price rise
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load cutlery. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Laundry: washing and drying work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Put work clothes in. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle to normal. Press start. Wait. Open dryer. Transfer clothes. Set dryer. Press start.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk to review study material and check tomorrow's roster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open study material. Read. Take notes. Open roster. Check schedule. Close laptop. Turn off lamp.
Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Wash face. Change into pajamas. Walk to bed. Pull back covers. Lie down. Close eyes. Pull covers up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
